articleTitle: Performance analysis of conventional and digital PWM control scheme for speed control of BLDC motor drives
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: This paper presents the performance analysis of conventional and digital pulse width modulation (PWM) control scheme for speed control of electronically commuted trapezoidal Brushless dc (BLDC) motor. Both these methods follow the PWM speed control strategy, only difference is in the controller part. One drive system consist of conventional PI controller and the other have digital controller. This paper includes discussion on the implementation of both the techniques and their performances are compared. Co-simulation of closed loop control systems are modeled by using Xilinx Integrated Software Environment (ISE) simulator and MATLAB/Simulink. Experimental test setup is carried out using field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA). Simulation results and effectiveness of the methods are proved and validated by experimental results. The results of the two techniques are compared and conclusions are made.

articleTitle: Low cost fuzzy logic based speed control of BLDC motor drives
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In this article, an embedded system approach for closed-loop speed control of BLDC motor drive is implemented and its performance with Proportional Integral control (PI) and fuzzy controllers are investigated. The PI controller is well designed and its parameters are well tuned by using Ziegler Nichols method. The fuzzy controller is also designed and considered for comparison. The performance of the system is studied under various operating conditions, such as sudden change in the reference speed and load torque. For validating the results, steady-state error and rise time are taken in account for comparison. It is observed that fuzzy controller provide a superior speed response compared to PI and better speed tracking make this to fit in adjustable speed drives. The simulation is carried out in MATLAB software and implemented the same in hardware.

articleTitle: Automatic check-post and fast track toll system using RFID and GSM module with security system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In present situation vehicle checking is huge trouble to the people with regard to license, insurance and RC book. It brings on traffic bother and also in toll gate system traffic jam occurs, time and fuel absorption is elongated. The automated toll accumulation system is very successful right now. This paper has to do with Automated Toll collection and Check-Post system using Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) and Global System for Mobile communications (GSM) module. The recognition is succeeded with the guidance of passive radio frequency. This project associate vehicle particulars like unique ID is saved in an RFID tag which is attached in the vehicle. After all the specifications are effectively observe through a computer, it can be saved on a data bank for cyclic gap as for time and date. Individual users clinch the unique ID for their vehicles. When the vehicle crosses the Toll-Plaza the reader reads the tag and the tax amount will be detected from their account balance by employing of RFID and GSM module. ATmega328 Arduino controller has to be associated with a GSM network which will capacitate a user to control the system by dispatching SMS or a forming a call and also avoid the stealing of vehicle.

articleTitle: Modeling and performance analysis of perturb & observe, incremental conductance and fuzzy logic MPPT controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: This paper presents the modeling of three different control techniques used in solar power generation systems using MATLAB Simulink. These techniques are namely Perturb and Observe (P&O), Incremental Conductance (IC) and Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) algorithms. These algorithms are introduced in the circuit to facilitate Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT). This paper also deals with the analysis and performance evaluation of these three techniques. The P-V and I-V characteristics are obtained for various values of solar irradiation with the cell temperature kept constant. All the algorithms works in association with a DC-DC converter. In this paper a boost converter is utilized for the realization of maximum power point tracking. The results of the three techniques are compared are made based on the factors like PV array dependence, oscillations at maximum power point, algorithm complexity and convergence speed, and suitable conclusions are made.

Author Keywords: Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) and Perturb and Observe (P&O)

articleTitle: Recent trends in sustainable development of renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Sustainable development is the optimum use of natural resources and adoption of advanced technologies. Solar power in India has an ambitious target and is expected to achieve grid parity by 2022. The national grid is a hybrid AC/DC transmission system. This operates synchronously with five regions including the North-East with 765kV and 400kV AC with +/- 500kV HVDC lines and back-to-back links. Renewable energy sources viz. wind power integration pose technical challenges to the grid, including reactive power and stability. Hybrid AC/DC Micro grid consists of conventional AC grid in combination with a DC grid. Power sources to the Micro grid can be any combination of renewable sources. An emerging trend is that home loads are moving towards DC. Transport sector is witnessing the growth of hybrid electric cars and buses. Electric buses run on Li-ion batteries due to their technical advantages. Alternatively, Ultra capacitors are used when fast-charging is required. Energy-efficiency is becoming more relevant in all areas eg. Motors and transformers. The Indian Standard for distribution transformers has been revised in Nov. 2014 to bring it on par with corresponding International Standards.

articleTitle: Automatic multi machine operation with product sorting and packaging by their colour and dimension with speed control of motors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In today's world of technology and due to speed running industries, automated machine is increased in this globalised world. Over the years, the demand increases for high quality, greater efficiency and automatic machines. Generally, manufacturing industries keep manufacturing same models with little variation in height, colour, weight, shape. And here sorting plays an important role. In such cases industries can't bare human errors for sorting these products. Thus it become necessary to develop Low Cost Automation (LCA) for sorting these products in accurate manner. Industrial automation mainly focuses on developing automations having low cost, low maintenance, long durability and to make systems user friendly as possible. And controlling various machines like different motors at the same time become a difficult task. Finally, here we have developed a LCA system for Multi machine operation and sorting the light weight objects on the basis of height variation using DC geared motors along with induction motor and stepper motors which is controlled by Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) and the conveyor in the system passes the object in front of sensors and thus sorting logic is decided. The project mainly focuses on level, positioning, speed and flow control at the various stages of the project plant.

articleTitle: A virtual model to analyze congestion in a wireless sensor network (WSN)
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: To share data between several devices we need a network connection. The devices can be any electronic device which works on data transfer protocols, e.g. computer, laptop, smartphone, wired/wireless sensors, routers etc. These network can be of wired or wireless or a combination of both. In wired connection, these are stationary to each other where as in wireless network the probability of changing the relative position between them is high. Devices in wireless network uses cell or battery to get energy instead from a direct source of electricity. For each change in network setup, it needs to recalculate the path of packet transfer. In a dense area, i.e. area containing more devices than the others, congestion rate is high because of same route selected by more number of devices. In the presented paper we deal with sensors as the network device. Increase of congestion leads to many consequences like decision delay, loss of data in the form of packets, increased overhead while retransmission of dropped packets, energy loss due to increased work load by sensors and reduced life span of sensors. A virtual model is presented in this paper which will help in understanding how the data are shared with in a network of sink node and sensors and a method to detect and control congestion in a network setup.

Author Keywords: sink node congestion and Wireless Sensor Network (WSN)

articleTitle: Single bit hybrid full adder cell by gate diffusion input and pass transistor logic technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In this paper, single bit full adder hybrid circuit has been proposed which consist of two techniques i.e. Pass transistor Logic (PTL) and Gate Diffusion Technique (GDI). Several logic families are described by PTL which is utilized in the architecture of integrated circuits. PTL technique is used to decreases the number of transistors in the circuits to make different gates of logic by eradicating redundant transistors. GDI technique is utilized for the low power consumption. In this paper CADENCE VIRTUOSO tool is being used and all the simulation work is done on it by utilizing the technology node at 180nm along with a supply voltage of 1.8V. The simulation result represents that the proposed architecture of single bit hybrid full adder cell absorbs 53% less power in comparison with hybrid full adder [5], 5% less power in comparison with 3T XNOR [6], 58% less power in comparison with 8T full adder cell [6] and 86% less power in comparison with Adder using MDCVSL [8]. As we know that power and propagation delay both are varying inversely but still the propagation delay is not affected much and it is almost similar than the existing designs.

articleTitle: Low power adaptive modulation technique in wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In this paper discuss digital communication modulation techniques Binary phase shift keying (BPSK) and Quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) modulation scheme is widely used to improve spectral efficiency in modern communication. QAM constellation structure (16, 64,128,256, etc. gives high data rate. FFT/IFFT plays a main role in or modern communication both techniques is used to convert DIT/DIF. Hence, as a fact, it does not matter whether you apply FFT (IFFT) at transmitter as long as you apply the reverse transform; IFFT (FFT) at the receiver. The signals need to be modulated by say N-QAM of the orthogonal subcarriers. Using FFT reduces the separation between the orthogonal sub-carriers. Consider a sinusoid of duration T seconds and with frequency k/T where k is a positive integer. It makes two such sinusoids as orthogonal as you want by spacing them far apart in the frequency domain so that their spectra do not overlap much. However, this is a waste of spectrum because ideally two such sinusoids which are spaced 1/T apart in frequency are orthogonal.

Author Keywords: Binary phase shift keying (BPSK) Decimation In Time(DIT)

articleTitle: Improving transient stability of power system using UPFC with PID and POD controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Inter area oscillations are common in power systems, where number of sources connected together with weak tie lines. These oscillations are undesirable and they reduce the efficient operation of grid. Damping of such inter area oscillations are more important while considering the grid stability. In this paper, we analyse the inter area oscillations in power systems and damping techniques with Unified power flow controller (UPFC) with Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) and Power Oscillation Damping (POD) controllers.

articleTitle: Damping out system oscillations in power system using UPFC for various faults
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Electrical power system is a huge connected network that requires uninterrupted power supply. A simple fault can cause severe losses. FACTS devices (i.e. STATCOM, and UPFC) have a huge impact on bringing the power system back to its stable state after a fatal fault on the system and also dampingout the transients. The power electronic device named as UPFC has an efficient control over power system. This paper describes the model to damp out system oscillations using UPFC.

articleTitle: Honey bee mating algorithm based location of UPFC for voltage stability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Optimization is an important technique followed to make the best possible use of a power system. Now a day's voltage instability problems in a power system have become one of the most concerns in power industries. By showing the voltage stability enhancement which will further lead to improvement in the system performance, reduction of the losses, and making the system more secure. In this paper the load flow analysis is done for IEEE 14 Bus system using Newton Raphson method without applying any algorithm. Later, optimization is done using the Advanced Honey Bee Algorithm and is tested in an IEEE-14 Bus power system. By using this optimization technique, the power losses are reduced and higher convergence is obtained. The results are obtained for the above mentioned algorithms using the MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Real-time implementation of phasor measurement unit using NI CompactRIO
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Phasor measurement unit (PMU) is certainly a massive boon in the wide-area measurement system which facilitates synchronized real-time measurements of remote areas present in the grid. In this paper, Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) is implemented in LabVIEW for real-time monitoring of various power system quantities. PMU is designed and simulated in LabVIEW and implemented in real-time using NI CompactRIO with the help of Global Positioning System (GPS) receivers. Non-recursive and Recursive Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) algorithms have been used to estimate voltage and current phasors time tagged with Universal Coordinated Time (UTC). Frequency and Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) have also been estimated in real time.

articleTitle: Integration of solar PV — Micro hydro power system for household application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Solar Photo Voltaic Panels penetrates Indian market at large extent. Even though the net metering and other advanced control system has been developed, energy storage part needs much more attention. Even in on grid system there is an darkness on using these power during the interruption of grid power. This paper attempts a novel methodology for replacing the conventional energy storage mechanism. The solar PV panel is directly operates the DC motor and lift the water. The fluctuation on the intensity increase or decrease the discharge of water. From the storage tank a drainage pipeline will be put up and as and when the power is needed the water is drained and micro hydro turbine will be operated. Micro hydro turbine is coupled to a generator and water has been drained directly to the sump. There is no maintenance cost involved in this system. These conversion process is fully eco-friendly techniques and full fill the green building technology.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of logic gates using single electron nano-devices
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Single electron semiconductor device is a 3 terminal Nano-electronic device which might offers low power consumption with high operative speed. SET can retain its scalability and management the motion of individual electrons. In this paper, we have given the simulated and comparative analysis study of logic gates with the mix of typical CMOS devices, SET and also in hybrid circuits. The logic gates are NOT, NOR and NAND designed and simulated using SPICE machine and analysed the performance.

articleTitle: Hybrid algorithm based location of UPFC for voltage stability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Now a day's voltage instability problems in a power system have become one of the most important concerns in electrical domain. In order to rectify this problem, various type of FACTS controllers are used. Among them we tend to prefer UPFC controller as it proves to be a versatile FACTS Controllers. We conduct the load flow analysis on the IEEE 14 bus system using Newton Raphson method to find the voltage stability index and L-index. Based on the parameters obtained we locate the UPFC controller in the power system. Then we apply the Hybrid algorithm which incorporates Honey bee mating algorithm and Plant growth Simulation algorithm, to conduct the load flow analysis using Newton Raphson Method. Here we find that Hybrid optimization technique brings in results with more convergence.

articleTitle: Analysis of transient stability using UPFC for symmetrical faults
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: A Power System is basically a huge network that needs an excellent design for the continuous flow of power. When a fault occurs at the power system, a series of problems arise due to occurrence of transients. In order to minimize this transients, devices like FACTS are used. This paper gives the stability analysis of power system without and with using UPFC with the help of PID and POD controller.

articleTitle: Image retargeting based on object inpainting and background seam carving
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: Image Retargeting is the most important Image resizing techniques in the digitalized world. In this paper, we find the solution for images retargeting technique using harvest festival images. The proposed technology is called Object-CRIST (Content Retargeting Image Seam Carving Technique). The method is a combination of two resizing Methods Region based object inpainting and resizing background image seam carving. The first method identifies the objects in the image and performs Region based retargeting. Second method works on image background regions. We evaluate Object-CRIST method on harvest festival image dataset. The experiment result of proposed system outperforms rest of all retargeting methodologies. The Result accuracy is calculated based on Resolution and Mean Opinion Score (MOS).

articleTitle: Development of micro wind turbine for rural livelihood improvement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: As per the world potential wind energy mapping, India has a wind potential of 1kW/km2 thought the country. In 1980 per wind machine capacity is 30kW is now gone up to 5MW. However throughout India Small Wind Turbine Potential is available. Hence this paper aims in developing a micro wind turbine of 100 W capacity and study its performance and reliability. Based on 50m Wind Monitoring Station at Gandhigram Rural Institute, Dindigul, Tamilnadu, shows the wind potential of 3m/s is available at 30m height in all the months. Hence the designed turbine has installed in roof tops and able to produce 100W continuous power output. The weight of the machine is very low and the noise produced is also low, the tower should be constructed under bamboo reinforcement. If the system penetrates in rural areas will increase the rural livelihoods in two modes, they are getting reliable power and the unemployed youths will be trained to build and erect this micro wind turbine which increased the employability opportunities.

Author Keywords: micro wind turbine and The Controller

articleTitle: Optimal capacitor placement and sizing in distribution system using hybrid approach of PSO-GA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: A distributed system is referred as an interface among bulky power system and consumers. In such distributed systems the voltage of the power grid is decreased when it moves at far from substations. Other problems are loss of power during transmission, variable voltage profile, increasing cost of system etc. Capacitors are used for performance enhancement of the system. Because all of these factors or problems directly affected by performance or energy efficiency of the system. There are various methods which are used for optimal placement of the capacitors in distributed power system. In this work the hybrid approach which combines two techniques such as GA and State transition have been developed in order to achieve the energy efficient distributed system. The result section proves the performance of proposed work by comparing the various techniques with proposed work.

articleTitle: Power factor improvement of agriculture feeder by using capacitor banks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: In rural areas the Transmission and Distribution losses are high due to various reasons like inductive and isolated loads, outdated infrastructure, transformer overloading and low power factor. This study aims to quantify the T & D losses in rural areas through power flow simulation. The study also analyses the possibility of losses reduction in these areas. The village under study is ‘Malshi’ and Power Factor in this region is identified to be particularly low. The reduction in losses possible though fixing of capacitor banks and improving power factor is quantified in this study. Cost analysis for such an intervention is also done in succeeding sections. The second major part of the study involves actual implementation of capacitor banks in the field (under a single transformer) and quantifying the losses reduced. The ultimate aim of this study is analyzing the feasibility of a project where MSEDCL could invest and install capacitors at lowest distribution level possible. Actual implementation helped identifying the various technical and policy limitations involved in implementing such a project. The project is also compared with more centralized form of solutions like single large capacitor installation (rather than at each load) and reactive power supply through decentralized generation.

articleTitle: Power factor correction of four switch BLDC motor drive using bridgeless-CSC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: A performance comparison of Bridgeless-CSC converter with the diode bridge rectifier is proposed in this paper. The diode bridge rectifier is generally used to convert ac to dc. The power factor can be improved by employing the LC filter. The harmonic distortion in the supply is high reducing the power quality. But when these performance is of major concern, the Bridgeless-CSC converter can be implemented which improves those parameters. The output from proposed converter is fed to the BLDC motor. The BLDC motor with four switch reduces the switching losses. The BL-CSC converter has two switches in which one conducts at each half cycle reducing the conduction losses.

articleTitle: Modified multilevel Quasi Z inverter for solar irrigation systems with improved control technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of Dual voltage control in new modified Quasi Z Source inverter applied for solar water pumping systems. The new two stage inverter produces buck/boosted multi-level AC voltage with reduced circuitry, minimized inrush current and mitigated harmonics. During climatic disturbances, the proposed new topology can execute dual control over the inverter voltage and maintains a steady performance of the water pump. Operating conditions are set to have an effective smooth control over the voltage on both DC and AC side with minimized switching losses in the system. Mathematical modeling and simulations are performed in MATLAB/Simulink to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed dual control with solar water pump model. Experimentation is carried out on a prototype model to validate the performance.

articleTitle: Investigation on PV fed hybrid electric vehicles with various power electronic circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Advances in Electrical Technology for Green Energy (ICAETGT)
abstract: This paper presents the detailed investigation on PV fed hybrid electric vehicles with energy storage system. Significant growth of sustainable energy system leads to development of transportation sector with clean energy sources for better environment condition. Recent configuration in hybrid vehicle system along with merits and demerits are discussed in the paper. Further, battery management system and various power converter topologies for electric vehicle system is presented for enhancing the performance and reliability of the vehicles. Various operating modes are identified with various electrical parameters and presented for efficient power conversion.
